dimensions.assessment: Affects holders of federal land use permits, leases, easements, and water users (including Indian Tribes) interacting with the Departments of the Interior and Agriculture.
dimensions.evidence: prohibits Interior and USDA from conditioning the issuance or renewal of land use or occupancy agreements... on the transfer of any water right

dimensions.assessment: Alters administrative conditions for federal land permits and leases by prohibiting federal agencies from requiring water right transfers or imposing additional water use restrictions.
dimensions.evidence: shall not-- (1) condition the issuance, renewal, amendment, or extension of any permit... on the transfer of any water right

dimensions.assessment: The source does not provide specific figures on federal spending or economic effects.
Places statutory limitations on the policy development and permit-issuing authorities of the Secretaries of the Interior and Agriculture regarding state water rights.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary shall not-- (1) condition the issuance, renewal, amendment, or extension of any permit... on the transfer of any water right

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory restriction on federal land and resource management agencies.

missing_information: Quantitative economic impact or administrative cost estimates for federal agencies.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill restricts the Departments of the Interior and Agriculture from conditioning land use permits or leases on the transfer of water rights to the United States or imposing water restrictions beyond state law. It affects federal land management agencies, water users, and state water allocation authorities.
